title: Is severe care dependency in later life a metropolitan rather than a rural burden in Korea? Evidence from long-term care insurance certifications — analysis code
description: Code-only archive of a district-level analysis of long-term care insurance grade 1-2 certifications among residents aged 65+ across 229 districts of South Korea, 2011-2024 (Bayesian spatiotemporal models in R-INLA). No data are included.
